posts.title: How to write a workplace wellness budget proposal leadership can evaluate
posts.intent: Build a wellness budget proposal around a clear workforce need, defined scope, verified costs and a review decision rather than unsupported savings promises.

evidence: Original workflow/proposal frameworks and fictional examples; brief CDC resources/planning context. No clinical, ROI, price, import or unverified feature promises.
topic_basis: November23 weekly hypotheses and coverage gaps; no fresh analytics or measured volume claim.
